meta.title: Divan | Coffeehouse & Kitchen
meta.description: Divan is a coffeehouse in Isfahan pairing specialty coffee with the heritage of Persian ghahveh-khaneh culture and poetry.

hero.title: Divan
hero.subtitle: Every cup, a verse in our daily ledger
hero.description: At Divan, brewing coffee is treated like reading a ghazal — slow, precise, and full of meaning. Fresh-roasted beans, house-baked bread, and a room built for staying a while.

categories.title: Browse the menu
categories.description: From single-origin espresso to a full Persian breakfast — everything has its page in this ledger.

gallery.title: A look inside Divan
gallery.description: Light through old window frames, steam off the cup, and the low hum of conversation.

ambiance.title: A house built for staying
ambiance.description: Divan lives inside a restored Isfahani house — brick vaults, a central courtyard, and light that changes color by the hour. A place to work, meet friends, or just sit with a book.

footer.tagline: Divan — a ledger of coffee, poetry, and long conversations.
footer.address: Chaharbagh Abbasi St., Narenjestan Alley No. 12, Isfahan
footer.newsletter_desc: Fresh cups and poetry nights, straight to your inbox.

menu_page.title: Divan Menu
menu_page.description: Every drink and dish at Divan, sorted like the verses of a long ghazal.

contact_page.title: Find Divan
contact_page.description: For table reservations, private events, or just to say hello — leave a message or call us.
